verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a SaaS AI product (Visalaw AI), so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no API, no API keys and no permission scoping. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
